reviewed_branches.observation: readonly_shm skips initial RW|CREATE SHM open. Failed O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW sets SQLITE_CANTOPEN and exits.
unixShmMap returns a non-OK unixOpenSharedMemory result without conversion.
Only SQLITE_READONLY_CANTINIT enables heap WAL-index fallback; other errors, including CANTOPEN, return directly.
unix-posix registration is compile conditional; it is explicit, with no runtime alternate VFS permitted.

W03_preconditions: Exact explicitly selected unix-posix VFS is present.
Ordinary WAL, no immutable or exclusive/heap mode and no existing in-process SHM handle.
Existing SHM file permitted for metadata/preguards but kernel denies SHM file-read-data.
W03_expected: Actual SHM data-open denial and SQLite CANTOPEN; no captured row. READONLY_CANTINIT fallback is a different branch and is not prohibited or misclassified by this case.
recognition_limit: W03 alone does not prove readonly_shm recognition, because an unknown parameter plus a rejected RW open could also reach the same denied read. Combine exact installed sqlite_source_id, required VFS and W01 successful read under actual write-denying sandbox.
scope: Source implementation and fixed synthetic case sources allowed. No host execution, production read, capture replay, cap inflation or weaker guards approved.
